ambient_events: The shelving ticks under the weight of the tins.
The pen on its string swings very slightly, and stops.
description: A storage room. A hand-lettered sign on the door: ST GARNEAU'S FOOD PANTRY FOR THE POOR. Wire shelving, mostly tins, labels all facing out. A clipboard on a nail by the door with a sheet headed TAKEN, a pen on a string, and the honour system written across the top. The recent lines are in other hands and are scrawls.
name: St Garneau's Food Pantry
